* [[Titan Armor]]

== Notes ==
* Shares his spawn point with [[Valetudo Rubor]], [[Maligo Libens]], [[Moles Quibus]] and [[Scelus Prosum]].
* All five bosses spawn in the four locations shown. The two western locations is really one large area with three bosses. The other two spawn points have a single boss each.
* In the western spawn points, one boss can be seen patrolling while the other two will spawn out of the lava after about 5 minutes.

== Trivia ==
* Tortitudo Probo is roughly translated in Latin as 'I demonstrate cruelty" or "I approve wickedness". Note that, because the word "tortitudo" is feminine, a grammatically correct translation into Latin would be "Tortitudinem Probo".
